posts.topic: Procurement ROI Is Proven. Data Foundation Isn't.
posts.hook: Procurement digitization already delivers median ROI. Most organizations still can't capture it.
posts.key_stat: 2.7x-6.6x median ROI across 200+ projects, yet 74% say their data is not AI-ready.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card leading with 2.7x-6.6x, contrasting the proven ROI figure against the 74% AI-readiness gap in a secondary line.
